title: Judge path resolves Vertex providers then formats via adapter_class
answers: How does a judge send a request to a gateway provider
Where does the judge path pick the provider for vertex_ai
Which code formats judge requests before posting
body:
Judge requests flow: GatewayAdapter._invoke_and_handle_tools (mlflow/genai/judges/adapters/gateway_adapter.py) resolves the provider with _get_provider_instance("vertex_ai", model_name) (mlflow/metrics/genai/model_utils.py), then calls provider.adapter_class.chat_to_model and posts with send_chat_request.
So provider hooks such as _prepare_payload are skipped here; anything the provider needs on the wire must be done in the adapter.
Tests for this seam: tests/gateway/providers/test_vertex_ai.py covers adapter-only formatting and provider resolution via _get_provider_instance.
applies: Debugging judge or scorer failures against gateway providers, especially Vertex AI.
says: Automated judge evaluation fails when scoring outputs through the Vertex AI gateway.
Scorer requests sent to Vertex AI model providers are missing required payload formatting.
Evaluation benchmarks crash when connecting to generative models hosted on Vertex AI.
Support proper chat request formatting when running evaluation judges against Vertex AI.
Model quality judge fails to send chat evaluation prompts to gateway providers.
search: In GenAI judge evaluations, GatewayAdapter._invoke_and_handle_tools resolves providers with _get_provider_instance("vertex_ai", model_name) and formats requests via provider.adapter_class.chat_to_model before posting with send_chat_request. Because provider hooks like _prepare_payload are skipped in this path, all wire-level formatting must be handled inside the adapter. This applies when debugging judge or scorer failures against gateway providers like Vertex AI, with tests in tests/gateway/providers/test_vertex_ai.py.
